title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise ranking of completion log-probabilities for local (non-Western) versus Western-associated entities in fill-in-the-blank tasks, using context prefixes with and without explicit cultural cues (via the CAMeL and Camellia benchmarks).
Evaluating stereotypical preference rates and stereotype scores on stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences to ensure no degradation, using the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet benchmarks.
